title: 💧 Meera's emergency fund covered six months... of the wrong number #emergencyfund #money
title_alts: Meera's emergency fund: how many months of bills it covers
Why Meera's salary-based emergency fund locked up spare cash
description_hook: An emergency fund is a count of months, not a multiple of salary. Meera's two numbers show what the difference costs.

round illustrative assumption paired with the spending figure

scenes.narration: One choice of number decides how many months the cushion lasts.

scenes.image_brief: A calendar page with six months shaded in blue and a row of coin stacks lined up under the shaded weeks, bright desk lamp light

scenes.caption: कुशन महीने खरीदता है। महीने खर्च से बनते हैं, कमाई से नहीं।

scenes.narration: Savings, taxes and investments leave the budget the moment income stops.

scenes.narration: Six months of Meera's spending is three lakh rupees.
scenes.caption: मीरा के छह महीने के खर्च तीन लाख रुपये हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Three even stacks of banknotes on a bare table beside a handwritten card reading six months of spending, clean daylight

scenes.narration: Six months of her salary is four lakh eighty thousand.
scenes.caption: छह महीने की सैलरी चार लाख अस्सी हज़ार बनती है।
scenes.image_brief: Five stacks of banknotes on the same bare table, the last stack shorter than the rest, beside a handwritten card reading six months of salary, clean daylight

scenes.narration: Salaried and steady? Six months of spending is the usual yardstick.
scenes.caption: पक्की नौकरी? छह महीने का खर्च आम पैमाना माना जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A graph-paper chart pinned to a corkboard showing twelve identical monthly bars in a flat even row, soft lamp light

scenes.narration: Irregular income needs more. Money that can fall is not a cushion.
scenes.caption: अनियमित कमाई में ज़्यादा चाहिए। घट सकने वाला पैसा कुशन नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A graph-paper chart with wildly uneven monthly bars and two months missing entirely, next to a glass jar of coins resting on a tilted shelf, dim evening light

scenes.narration: The gap between those two numbers is one lakh eighty thousand.

scenes.image_brief: Two unequal piles of banknotes on a desk with a steel measuring tape stretched between them marking the difference, overhead light

scenes.narration: That is capital sitting idle to solve a problem nobody had.
scenes.caption: इतनी पूंजी बेकार पड़ी रही, ऐसी दिक्कत के लिए जो थी ही नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A dusty sealed cash box on a storeroom shelf with a faded paper label reading just in case, a single shaft of light through a small window

scenes.narration: Add last month's fixed bills, then multiply by six.
scenes.caption: पिछले महीने के तय बिल जोड़ें, फिर छह से गुणा करें।
scenes.image_brief: A printed bank statement of recurring debits on a table beside a notepad where the total has been multiplied by six in pencil, morning light

title: 📉 Arjun ignored the expense ratio... what one percent quietly costs #expenseratio #mutualfunds
title_alts: Arjun's expense ratio: the yearly fee taken from the fund itself
Arjun compared returns only... and missed the fee nobody billed
description_hook: A fund's expense ratio never shows up on a bank statement. Two identical funds show where the money actually goes.
setting: a fund factsheet and a twenty year holding period

claims.claim: One charges half a percent yearly
claims.basis: round illustrative fee level, presented as an illustrative case in the narration
round illustrative fee level, presented as an illustrative case in the narration

claims.claim: After twenty years the cheaper fund holds about a third more
claims.basis: compounding arithmetic on the illustrative one-and-a-half point fee gap over the stated horizon

scenes.narration: An expense ratio is charged whether a fund gains or loses.
scenes.caption: फंड बढ़े या घटे, एक्सपेंस रेशियो हर हाल में कटता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed fund factsheet on a desk with one line of the fee table circled in red ink, a pen lying across the page, cool daylight

scenes.narration: It is deducted daily from the fund's own value. No bill arrives.
scenes.caption: यह रोज़ फंड की वैल्यू से कटता है। कोई बिल नहीं आता।
scenes.image_brief: An empty letterbox mounted on a gate, and behind it a glass water jug losing a thin steady trickle through a hairline crack, morning light

scenes.narration: So where does the money go? It shows up as a gap in the balance.
scenes.caption: तो यह पैसा कहां जाता है? यह आख़िरी बैलेंस के फ़र्क में दिखता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical glass jars of coins side by side on a shelf, one filled noticeably lower than the other, a paper tag hanging from each jar, even indoor light

scenes.narration: The fee is taken before returns are reported. What remains compounds.
scenes.caption: फ़ीस रिटर्न बताने से पहले कटती है। बचा हिस्सा कंपाउंड होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tall stack of coins on a table with the second coin from the bottom slid out and set aside, the stack leaning slightly, warm lamp light

scenes.narration: So a fee removes this year's rupees and everything they would have earned.
scenes.caption: इस तरह फ़ीस इस साल के रुपये और उनकी आगे की कमाई, दोनों ले जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A young tree in a clay pot with one lower branch cut off and lying on the soil beside it, the rest of the canopy full and leafy, soft garden light

scenes.narration: Two funds hold identical shares, a round illustrative case.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए दो फंड एक जैसे शेयर रखते हैं, यह सिर्फ़ उदाहरण है।
scenes.image_brief: Two open ledger books lying flat on a table showing matching lists of company names, a small brass weight resting on each page, plain daylight

scenes.narration: One charges half a percent yearly. The other charges two.
scenes.caption: एक साल में आधा फ़ीसदी लेता है। दूसरा दो फ़ीसदी लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two paper price tags tied to the handles of two identical jute sacks of grain, one tag far larger than the other, bright market light

scenes.narration: After twenty years the cheaper fund holds about a third more.
scenes.caption: बीस साल बाद सस्ते फंड में करीब एक तिहाई ज़्यादा पैसा बचता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two clear measuring jars of rice standing on a kitchen counter, the left jar filled higher, a strip of masking tape marking each level, window light

scenes.narration: Cheapest is not a rule.
scenes.caption: सबसे सस्ता चुनना कोई नियम नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A single price tag lying face down on an empty wooden table, nothing else in frame, flat even light

scenes.narration: An index-tracking fund charges little because nobody picks stocks. Active funds charge for the attempt.
scenes.caption: इंडेक्स फंड कम लेता है, कोई शेयर नहीं चुनता। एक्टिव फंड कोशिश का पैसा लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: One side of a room holding a copier tray with a duplicated list of company names, the other side a desk covered with annual reports, sticky notes and a magnifying glass, office light

scenes.narration: Future returns are unknown.
scenes.caption: आगे का रिटर्न किसी को पता नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A sealed envelope standing upright on a bare desk with a blank white label on its front, dim even light

scenes.narration: The fee is the one number known in advance.
scenes.caption: फ़ीस ही वह आंकड़ा है जो पहले से पता होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A factsheet page on a desk with the annual fee figure printed in bold type and the rest of the page left blank, crisp daylight

scenes.narration: Find the expense ratio on the factsheet before comparing two funds.
scenes.caption: दो फंड तुलना करने से पहले फ़ैक्टशीट में एक्सपेंस रेशियो देखें।
scenes.image_brief: Two fund factsheets placed side by side on a table with the fee line on each marked in yellow highlighter, a narrow gap between the pages, desk lamp light

title: 🌀 Kavya paid the minimum due every month... why the balance grew #creditcard #minimumdue
title_alts: Kavya's minimum due: what that small figure on the card bill does
Kavya trusted the minimum due... and lost her interest-free days
description_hook: The minimum due on a card bill is the smallest amount that keeps an account in good standing. It is not the amount that clears the debt.

claims.basis: round illustrative balance, stated as illustrative in the narration

claims.claim: The minimum might be two thousand five hundred
claims.basis: round illustrative five percent slice of the illustrative balance, not a published figure

scenes.narration: The minimum due keeps an account current, not clear.
scenes.caption: मिनिमम ड्यू खाता चालू रखता है, बकाया खत्म नहीं करता।
scenes.image_brief: A credit card statement on a table with the minimum due box printed in bold and the total due line much fainter above it, cold overhead light

scenes.narration: Card interest is charged every month on whatever stays unpaid.
scenes.caption: कार्ड पर बचे हुए बकाया पर हर महीने ब्याज लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A kitchen sink where a thin stream of water runs steadily down an open drain, a plug resting unused on the counter beside it, dull daylight

scenes.narration: It compounds. The next month's interest includes last month's interest.
scenes.caption: यह कंपाउंड होता है। अगले महीने का ब्याज पिछले ब्याज पर भी लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: A snowball resting at the top of a snowy slope with a widening track of gathered snow below it, flat winter light

scenes.narration: Why does a shrinking balance take years? One number explains it.
scenes.caption: घटता बकाया सालों क्यों खिंचता है? एक आंकड़ा यह समझा देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar with dozens of months torn off and piled beneath it, one final page still hanging, weak afternoon light

scenes.narration: A minimum payment is set as a small slice of the balance.
scenes.caption: मिनिमम पेमेंट बकाया का एक छोटा हिस्सा तय किया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A large round loaf of bread on a wooden board with one very thin slice cut and moved aside, the rest of the loaf whole, warm kitchen light

scenes.narration: Pay that slice and interest is covered first. The borrowed amount barely moves.
scenes.caption: वह हिस्सा पहले ब्याज में जाता है। मूल रकम लगभग वहीं रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Two clear jars on a counter labelled interest and principal, coins filling the interest jar to the brim while only three coins sit in the other, side light

scenes.narration: Say fifty thousand sits unpaid, a round illustrative amount.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए पचास हज़ार बकाया है, यह आंकड़ा उदाहरण भर है।
scenes.image_brief: A neat bundle of banknotes on a plain table beside a handwritten card reading unpaid balance, clean even daylight

scenes.narration: The minimum might be two thousand five hundred. Most of it is interest.
scenes.caption: मिनिमम ढाई हज़ार हो सकता है। उसमें ज़्यादातर ब्याज होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A few banknotes lying next to the same large bundle, a small paper arrow pointing from the few notes towards a card reading interest, even daylight

scenes.narration: One trap is hidden. Paying the minimum ends the interest-free period on new spending.
scenes.caption: एक जाल छिपा है। मिनिमम भरते ही नई खरीद पर ब्याज-मुक्त दिन खत्म।
scenes.image_brief: A shop receipt for a fresh purchase lying on top of an old card statement, a small hourglass with all its sand already fallen standing beside them, dim light

scenes.narration: The minimum protects a credit score, not a wallet.
scenes.caption: मिनिमम क्रेडिट स्कोर बचाता है, जेब नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A printed credit score report lying flat and pristine next to an open empty wallet with its fold turned out, cool desk light

scenes.narration: Look for the words total amount due on the next statement.
scenes.caption: अगली स्टेटमेंट में 'टोटल अमाउंट ड्यू' शब्द ढूंढें।
scenes.image_brief: A credit card statement held flat on a table with the total amount due line traced under with a ruler and pencil, bright morning light

title: 🪨 Rohit stretched the loan to cut the EMI... what it really cost #emi #homeloan
title_alts: Rohit's loan tenure: how it moves the EMI and the total interest
Rohit chose the smallest EMI... and paid for it twice over
description_hook: Stretching a loan makes the monthly payment smaller and the loan itself more expensive. Rohit's two tenures show both numbers at once.

claims.claim: Take twenty lakh at a round illustrative ten percent
claims.basis: round illustrative loan size and rate, stated as illustrative in the narration

claims.claim: Ten years costs roughly twelve lakh in interest
claims.basis: standard amortisation arithmetic on the illustrative loan size, rate and tenure

claims.claim: Twenty years costs roughly twenty-six lakh
claims.basis: standard amortisation arithmetic on the same illustrative loan over the longer tenure

claims.claim: The monthly outgo falls by about seven thousand
claims.basis: difference of the two illustrative instalments computed from the figures already stated

claims.claim: The lifetime cost more than doubles
claims.basis: comparison of the two interest totals already stated in the narration

scenes.narration: A longer loan lowers the EMI and raises the total paid.
scenes.caption: लंबी अवधि से ईएमआई घटती है और कुल भुगतान बढ़ जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A repayment schedule printed on a long strip of paper unrolling off the edge of a desk and curling onto the floor, cool office light

scenes.narration: Each EMI splits in two. Interest comes first, principal second, and interest is charged only on what is still owed.
scenes.caption: हर ईएमआई दो हिस्सों में बंटती है। पहले ब्याज, फिर मूलधन, और ब्याज सिर्फ़ बचे बकाया पर।
scenes.image_brief: A single instalment receipt cut cleanly into two unequal pieces on a table, the larger piece labelled interest and the smaller labelled principal, plain daylight

scenes.narration: Tenure decides how long that owing lasts.
scenes.caption: अवधि तय करती है कि बकाया कितने साल टिका रहेगा।
scenes.image_brief: Two calendars hung side by side on a wall, one showing ten year markers and the other twenty, a length of twine stretched under each, soft indoor light

scenes.narration: Early instalments are mostly interest, because the outstanding balance is still large.
scenes.caption: शुरू की ईएमआई ज़्यादातर ब्याज होती है, क्योंकि बकाया तब बड़ा है।
scenes.image_brief: A bar chart drawn on graph paper where the first bars are almost entirely shaded dark and the last bars almost entirely light, pinned above a desk, lamp light

scenes.narration: Stretch the tenure and that balance stays large for many more years.
scenes.caption: अवधि खींचने पर वही बकाया कई साल तक बड़ा बना रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: A long straight road running to the horizon with milestone posts spaced far apart and a heavy stone tied to the nearest post, hazy afternoon light

scenes.narration: Take twenty lakh at a round illustrative ten percent.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए बीस लाख का कर्ज़, ब्याज दस फ़ीसदी, सिर्फ़ उदाहरण के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: A loan agreement page on a desk with the amount and the rate filled in by hand in the blank spaces, a pen resting on the signature line, crisp daylight

scenes.narration: Ten years costs roughly twelve lakh in interest.
scenes.caption: दस साल में ब्याज करीब बारह लाख बैठता है।
scenes.image_brief: A modest pile of banknotes on the left half of a bare table beside a card reading ten years, even daylight

scenes.narration: Twenty years costs roughly twenty-six lakh. Same loan.
scenes.caption: बीस साल में करीब छब्बीस लाख। कर्ज़ उतना ही।
scenes.image_brief: A pile of banknotes more than twice as tall on the right half of the same bare table beside a card reading twenty years, even daylight

scenes.narration: Is the longer tenure always wrong? No.
scenes.caption: तो लंबी अवधि हमेशा गलत है? नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A household budget sheet on a table with a small monthly instalment figure circled and the grocery and school fee lines left intact, warm kitchen light

scenes.narration: A smaller instalment can keep a household solvent, and prepayment shortens the term later.
scenes.caption: कम ईएमआई घर चलाए रख सकती है, और आगे प्रीपेमेंट अवधि घटा देती है।
scenes.image_brief: A repayment schedule with the last several rows folded back and creased away, a pair of scissors lying beside the folded edge, desk light

scenes.narration: The monthly outgo falls by about seven thousand. The lifetime cost more than doubles.
scenes.caption: हर महीने करीब सात हज़ार बचते हैं। पूरी लागत दोगुनी से ज़्यादा हो जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A balance scale on a counter with a few small coins in one pan and a towering stack of banknotes in the other, the beam tipped hard to one side, even light

scenes.narration: Ask any lender for the total interest at two different tenures.
scenes.caption: किसी भी लेंडर से दो अलग अवधियों का कुल ब्याज पूछें।
